facts.claim: Reverse DCF: earnings-based, Ke 10.5% (rf 4.2%, ERP 5.5%, beta 1.15), implies 5.9-7.7%/yr net-income growth; base 9-11% or 5-7%; implied_vs_base "below"
facts.source: Recomputed on P/TCE-ROTCE (bank method): market cap $171.3B (1,729.3M x 99.03); company average tangible common equity $25.3B -> P/TCE 6.8x; ROTCE 44% annualized Q2, 41% H1 (release); Ke = 5.17% + Blume beta 0.834 (raw 0.753) x 4.14% = 8.62%, g 3%
facts.source_value: Required sustained ROTCE = 3% + 6.8 x 5.62% = 41%, equal to H1 2026 actual (41%) and below Q2 (44%); at the dossier beta 1.15 (Ke 9.7%) required ROTCE is 49%
facts.note: Net-income growth is not distributable cash for a bank (growth consumes capital), the rate used a 4.2% risk-free rate (UST is 5.17%) and a 5.5% ERP. On the program bank method the price roughly capitalizes current ROTCE: in_line, not below. Sensitive to beta.
